title:
Comment of Debbie Gries in Docket(s)/Project(s) P-15424-000
Submission Date: 10/19/2026

documents.name: 151690.txt
documents.text:
Debbie Gries, Keyport, NJ.
Hi,

Please do not move forward with the underwater data center. This will be gravely detrimental to the right whale and other sea life. We cannot keep decimating our oceans without dire consequences. At what point are we going to realize we have to work WITH our planet and its inhabitants and not against it??

Thank you for reading my comment.
